slack.description: DM Nicx in any Slack workspace

steps.s1: 1. Go to api.slack.com/apps → click "Create New App" → choose "From an app manifest"
steps.s2: 2. Select your workspace. When asked for the manifest format, choose JSON. Then paste the manifest below (click "Copy" to copy it):
steps.s3: 3. Click "Next" → review the summary → click "Create". Then go to "Install App" in the left sidebar → click "Install to Workspace" → click "Allow"
steps.s4: 4. In the left sidebar, click "OAuth & Permissions". Copy the "Bot User OAuth Token" (starts with xoxb-...)
steps.s5: 5. In the left sidebar, click "Basic Information" → scroll to "App-Level Tokens" → click "Generate Token and Scopes" → name it "socket" → click "Add Scope" → select "connections:write" → click "Generate" → copy the token (starts with xapp-...)
steps.s6: 6. (Optional) Still in "Basic Information", scroll to "Display Information" → upload the Nicx icon as the app icon
steps.s7: 7. Paste both tokens below and click Connect

slack.howToUse: Open Slack and DM @Nicx to talk to it.

sendblue.subtitle: Let people text Nicx from any phone
sendblue.step1Intro: SendBlue lets Nicx send and receive iMessages and SMS. You need an account and API credentials.
sendblue.credentialsLink: 2. Go to your API Credentials page
sendblue.copyCredentials: Copy the "API Key" and "API Secret" from the credentials page and paste them below.
sendblue.step2Intro: Which phone number should SendBlue use? This is the number people will text to reach Nicx.
sendblue.step3Intro: SendBlue needs a public URL to send incoming messages to your local server. Use ngrok to create a tunnel.
sendblue.webhookDone: Webhook registered! Incoming texts will be forwarded to Nicx.
sendblue.webhookFailed: Failed to register webhook. Check your ngrok URL and SendBlue credentials.
sendblue.skipWebhook: You can also skip this step and register the webhook later.
